notes.title: Win10 Patch Live
notes.content:
Hi Star Wars fans!

We've just pushed out a patch that should address issues some users had running Battlegrounds on Win10.  Thanks for bringing the issue to our attention and being patient while we developed a solution.

We’re committed to making our great catalog of Star Wars, Lucas adventure and Disney/Pixar titles available and running smoothly everywhere our fans are.

Stay tuned for more updates from us!  #MT4BWY

- The Disney Big Picture Team
